responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s location abstractions for symbolic execution. function_point represents a position within a supernode or statement stream, while program_point pairs that location with a call_string to encode interprocedural context; the header also defines point_kind, ordering/hash support, stack-depth computation, navigation helpers, and call-stack update operations used throughout the exploded graph.
same_name_distinction: Declares the program-point data model—point_kind, function_point, and program_point—with their accessors and factory helpers; unlike program-point.cc, it defines the representation and API rather than the printing, comparison, and navigation implementations.
